expected_behavior: Report effective result PASS for the stipulated conflict, retaining both original values and the result conflict warning. Preserve semantic-source attribution when supplied and explicitly state missing record/source binding. This gold answer is an offline evaluation reference only; it grants no execution permission or planner authority.
